Doskada: ikki ustunli sxema chizing: «Klinik tashxis» va «Autopsiya/gistologiya». Tipik xato: OIV infeksiyasi va OITS ni bir xil tushunish; o‘lim sababi va oddiy yondosh topilmani farqlamaslik.

slides.title: OIV, OITS va opportunistik infeksiyalar

bullets.text: OIV chaqirgan immunitet tanqisligi opportunistik qo‘zg‘atuvchilarga yo‘l ochadi. MNTda eng ko‘p Toxoplasma gondii, Cryptococcus neoformans va CMV uchraydi.

bullets.text: OITSda markaziy asab tizimi (MNT) o‘pkadan keyin ikkinchi o‘rinda zararlanadi. O‘smalar orasida birlamchi non-Hodgkin limfomalari ustun turadi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: OIV ga xos o‘zgarishlar odatda kasallikning kech bosqichida paydo bo‘ladi. Ko‘p yadroli gigant hujayralar MNTda OIV uchun patognomonik deb hisoblanadi.

bullets.text: Diqqat: OIV ≠ OITS. 299 ta OIV-seropozitiv holatdan 9 tasi CDC (AQSh kasalliklarni nazorat qilish markazlari, 1993) mezonlariga mos kelmagani uchun chiqarilgan.

Doskada: «OIV → immunitet tanqisligi → opportunistik infeksiya → MNT/o‘pka zararlanishi» zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: OIV va OITS ni sinonim deb hisoblash; Toxoplasma, Cryptococcus va CMV ni bir-biridan farqlamaslik.

Eslatma: maxsus bo‘yoqlarning aniq qaysi qo‘zg‘atuvchiga mosligi bu manbada alohida ko‘rsatilmagan, shuning uchun jadvalda guruhlab berilgan.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. NTM – notuberkulyoz mikobakteriyalar. Muhokama: nega gistologiya va kultura natijalarini birga baholash kerak? Nega taloq kulturasi ishonchsiz bo‘lishi mumkin? Doskada chizing: 23 ta bakterial holat ichida Klebsiella, S. aureus, Pseudomonas ulushlari. Tipik xato: NTM (M. avium) ni sil qo‘zg‘atuvchisi M. tuberculosis bilan adashtirish va NTM foizini (3/34) bakteriyalar maxrajiga (23) qo‘shib yuborish.

slides.title: Kriptokokkoz, PCP va CMV

bullets.text: Kriptokokk kasalligi 4 ta (12%) o‘lganda topildi; 3 tasida (75%) gistologik dalil bor, 2 tasida C. neoformans o‘sdi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: CMV (sitomegalovirus) gistologiyada 2 ta (6%) holatda topildi, ikkalasida ham jarayon tarqalgan edi. PCP (Pneumocystis pnevmoniyasi) ham 2 ta (6%).

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Grokott (Grocott) bo‘yog‘ida o‘pkada kichik, yarim oysimon xamirturushsimon zamburug‘lar PCP uchun xarakterli; kriptokokklar alveolalarda polimorf ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Diqqat: likvorda CMV PCR musbat bo‘lishi (11 tadan 7 tasi) kasallik dalili hisoblanmadi; gistologik tasdiq kerak.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: Grokott bo‘yog‘i qaysi mikroorganizmlarni ko‘rsatadi? PCR musbat bo‘lsa, nega kasallik deyish mumkin emas? Doskada chizing: alveola ichida yarim oysimon PCP va polimorf kriptokokk xamirturushlari. Tipik xato: virus PCR natijasini gistologik tasdiqsiz kasallik deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Koinfeksiyalar: bir nechta infeksiya birga

bullets.text: 20 ta (59%) o‘lganda gistologik yoki kultura bo‘yicha kamida ikkita infeksiya bor edi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Sil topilgan 16 kishining 9 tasida (56%) bakterial, 2 tasida (13%) kriptokokk kasalligi ham aniqlandi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Sil bilan birga CMV, PCP va NTM ham har biri 1 tadan (6%) uchragan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Voqea tahlili: OIV bilan og‘rigan bemorda sil gistologik topilgan; shu o‘pkada bakterial pnevmoniya ham bor. Savol: sud-gistolog xulosada qaysi birini asosiy deb ko‘rsatadi va nega bitta topilma bilan to‘xtash xavfli? Doskada chizing: silga qo‘shilgan infeksiyalar zanjiri. Tipik xato: bitta infeksiya topilgach izlashni to‘xtatish.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: MIA topilmalari

bullets.text: 1-savol: 34 ta MIA (minimal invaziv autopsiya)da sil, bakterial infeksiya va kriptokokk qancha topildi? Javob: sil 16 ta (47%), bakterial 23 ta (68%), kriptokokk 4 ta (12%).

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: 2-savol: silda qaysi namuna kulturada eng ko‘p musbat berdi? Javob: bronxoalveolyar lavaj (BAL) – 7 ta; orqa miya suyuqligi (CSF) va taloq – 5 tadan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: 3-savol: koinfeksiya nega muhim? 34 tadan 20 tasida (59%) kamida ikki infeksiya bor edi; silli 16 kishining 9 tasida bakterial kasallik ham topildi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi. MIA ≠ to‘liq autopsiya: MIA ba’zi holatlarni o‘tkazib yuboradi. Ugandada gistologiya silni aniqlashda 71% sezgir, 100% o‘ziga xos bo‘lgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Talabalar javobni yopiq daftarda yozadi, so‘ng tekshiriladi. Muhokama: 1) Nega bir bemorda bir nechta infeksiya bo‘lishi mumkin? 2) Faqat sil davosi yetarlimi? Doskada: 34 ta MIA bo‘yicha sil, bakterial va kriptokokk ulushlarini ustunli sxemada chizing. Tipik xato: foizlarni bir-biriga qo‘shib yuborish; bir bemorda bir nechta infeksiya bo‘lgani uchun ular 100% bo‘lmaydi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili 3: MIA va davolanmagan sil

bullets.text: Vaziyat: CD4 past bemor nazorat guruhida, sil davosi boshlanmagan; MIAda jigar va taloqda granulomalar. Tadqiqotda silli 16 kishining 6 tasi davo olmagan, 5 tasi nazorat guruhida edi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Savol 1: qaysi namunalar tashxisni tasdiqlaydi? Gistologiyada Ziehl-Neelsen (ZN) bo‘yog‘i, mikobakteriya kulturasi va BAL namunasida Xpert MTB/RIF.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Savol 2: nega o‘pkada topilmasligi mumkin? Silli 14 kishida kasallik o‘pkadan tashqarida edi, shundan 3 tasida o‘pka zararlanishi umuman yo‘q edi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Gistologik sil topilgan 12 kishidan 2 tasida faqat jigar va taloqda, 2 tasida faqat o‘pkada o‘zgarish bor edi. Taloq biopsiyasi esa faqat 62% muvaffaqiyatli bo‘lgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Vaziyat manbadagi ma’lumotlarga tayanib soddalashtirilgan. Muhokama: 1) Bitta organ namunasi manfiy bo‘lsa silni inkor qilish mumkinmi? 2) Nega bir nechta organdan namuna olinadi? Doskada: o‘pka, jigar, taloq va BAL uchun qaysi usul (gistologiya, kultura, Xpert) qo‘llanishini jadvalda chizing. Tipik xato: o‘pkada o‘zgarish yo‘q = sil yo‘q deb xulosa qilish.

slides.title: Postmortem natijalarni talqin qilish qiyinchiliklari

bullets.text: M. tuberculosis o‘limdan keyin yillar davomida va formalinda saqlanganda ham tirik qolishi mumkin. Kultura musbat 11 kishidan 7 tasi o‘rtacha 122 kun sil davosi olgan edi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: O‘limdan ko‘p kun o‘tsa, to‘qima avtolizi va mikroorganizmlar translokatsiyasi (hayotda bo‘lmagan joyga o‘tishi) xavfi ortadi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Jasad sovutilgan bo‘lsa, o‘limdan autopsiyagacha o‘tgan vaqt yolg‘on musbat bakterial natijalarga katta ta’sir qilmaydi. Chaqaloqlar tadqiqotida uzoq oraliq hatto kamroq yolg‘on musbat bergan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Diqqat: kultura musbat ≠ faol kasallik. Natijalar klinika va gistologiya bilan birga baholanadi; artefaktni mikrobiolog ajratadi. Standart yo‘riqnoma ishlab chiqish taklif etilgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega kultura natijasini faqat o‘zi bilan baholab bo‘lmaydi? 2) Sovutish nima uchun muhim? Doskada: tashxis uchun klinika, gistologiya va mikrobiologiya uchburchagini chizing. Tipik xato: o‘limdan keyin olingan har bir musbat kulturani o‘lim sababi deb hisoblash.

slides.title: MIA ni kuzatuvda qo‘llash: eng samarali namunalar

bullets.text: Minimal invaziv autopsiyada (MIA) bronxoalveolyar lavaj (BAL) Xpert va kulturasi birga 9 ta silni aniqladi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: O‘pka to‘qimasi kulturasi yana 2 ta, o‘pka gistologiyasi yana 3 ta holatni qo‘shdi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Shu usullar jami autopsiyada topilgan sil holatlarining 88% ini qamrab oldi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: nega nafas yo‘li namunalari (BAL va o‘pka) eng yuqori natija beradi? Nega bir nechta usulni birga qo‘llash kerak? Doskada: to‘rt bosqichli zanjirni chizing va har bosqichga qo‘shilgan holatlar sonini yozing. Tipik xato: Xpert yagona yetarli usul deb o‘ylash. Manbada BAL namunasi bor, sil aniqlangan 14 holatning faqat 5 tasida Xpert musbat bo‘lgan (35,7%); uning autopsiyadagi o‘rni hali aniqlanmagan. Eslab qoling: BAL + kultura + gistologiya = 88%.

slides.title: Qo‘shimcha topilmalar va tadqiqot cheklovlari

bullets.text: Jigar gistologiyasi o‘tkazilgan 30 ta holatning 18 tasida (60%) yallig‘lanish topildi: 12 tasida steatoz, 5 tasida gepatit.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Buyrak namunalari olingan 13 holatning 6 tasida interstitsial nefrit va/yoki o‘tkir tubulyar nekroz aniqlandi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: Cheklov: autopsiya qamrovi taxminan 10% edi va barcha 34 ta MIA ni bitta operator bajara olmadi, shu sabab namuna olishda farq bo‘ldi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: MIA to‘liq autopsiyaga qaraganda kamroq ma’lumot beradi, ayniqsa noinfeksion tashxislarda, lekin oilalar uchun maqbulroq.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: jigardagi yallig‘lanish topilmalari OIV infeksiyasining o‘zi bilan bog‘liqmi? (Manbada bunday xulosa yo‘q; faqat 5 holatda virusli tabiat ehtimol deyilgan, shuni ta’kidlang.) MIA ning kamchiligi nima, afzalligi nima? Doskada: ikki ustunli ro‘yxat chizing: MIA afzalliklari va cheklovlari. Tipik xato: gepatit va steatozni bir xil jarayon deb aralashtirish; ular yallig‘lanish ichidagi alohida toifalar.

slides.title: Xulosa: sud-gistologik diagnostika xulosalari

bullets.text: 284 ta OIV autopsiyasining 58,1% da markaziy asab tizimida (MNT) muhim lezyon topildi, asosan infeksiyalar.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Muhim lezyonli 165 holatning 91 tasida (55,1%) hayotdagi va autopsiyadagi tashxis mos kelmadi; 49 tasi 1-tur xato edi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Janubiy Afrikada 34 autopsiyaning 16 tasida sil, 59% da kamida ikki infeksiya topildi; natijalarni gistologiya va klinika bilan birga baholash kerak.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE
source.page: PMID 27829072, Abstract; Discussion: Interpretation of autopsy findings

bullets.text: Yuqori faol antiretrovirus terapiya (HAART) olganlarda o‘rtacha omon qolish 49,1 oy, terapiyasizlarda 11,2 oy bo‘ldi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: nega gistologiya, kultura va klinik ma’lumotni birga baholash shart? Nega HAART ga qaramay autopsiya o‘z ahamiyatini yo‘qotmaydi? Doskada: to‘rt xulosani bitta qisqa zanjirga yig‘ing: autopsiya, topilma, hayotdagi tashxis bilan taqqos, davolash strategiyasi. Tipik xato: 17,2% va 17,6% ni aralashtirish; manbaning o‘zida ikki xil yozilgan, aniq qiymatni ikkilamchi tekshirish kerak.

mcq.question: Kasalxona rahbari: “HAART (yuqori faol antiretrovirus terapiya) va zamonaviy diagnostika davrida autopsiya keraksiz”, deb o‘ylaydi. Silva tadqiqotining qaysi natijasi bu fikrga eng yaxshi qarshi dalil bo‘ladi?
options: HAART guruhida yashash muddati A guruhdan to‘rt baravar uzun bo‘lgan
Klinik va autopsiya tashxisi 165 holatning 91 tasida bir-biriga mos kelmagan
OIV serologiyasi musbat holatlar barcha autopsiyalarning 16,7 foizini tashkil etgan
Ayollar ulushi 1997 yildan keyin 33 foizgacha oshgan
mcq.explanation: Miyada muhim o‘zgarishlar bor 165 holatning 91 tasida (55,1%) hayotiy va o‘limdan keyingi tashxis mos kelmagan. 49 holatda bu 1-tur xato bo‘lgan, ya’ni hayotida aniqlansa prognozni o‘zgartirishi mumkin edi. Bu HAART va ilg‘or diagnostika davrida ham autopsiya zarurligini ko‘rsatadi. Boshqa variantlar to‘g‘ri faktlar, lekin autopsiya zarurligini isbotlamaydi.

source.author: Silva AC va boshq.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation (AIDS Research and Treatment, 2012)

mcq.question: Tadqiqotchi vafot etgan OIV-musbat bemorning o‘pka, jigar va taloq to‘qimalaridan igna (biopsiya) yordamida namuna oldi, qon va orqa miya suyuqligini ham aspiratsiya qildi. Bu qaysi usul?
mcq.explanation: Karat tadqiqotida o‘pka, jigar va taloqdan core-biopsiya ignalari bilan to‘qima olingan, qon, orqa miya suyuqligi va siydik aspiratsiya qilingan, bronxoalveolyar lavaj olingan. Bu minimal invaziv autopsiya (MIA). To‘liq autopsiyada barcha organlar ko‘rilib namuna olinadi. Verbal autopsiya esa yaqinlar bilan tuzilgan intervyu.

source.author: Karat AS va boshq.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa (PLoS ONE, 2016)

mcq.question: Silva tadqiqotida markaziy nerv tizimini mikroskopik tekshirishning standart namunasi uchun gippokamp qaysi struktura bilan bitta blokda olinadi?
mcq.explanation: Standart kamida uchta blokdan iborat: turli bo‘laklardan bitta blok; bazal gangliyalar va gippokamp — bitta blok; o‘rta miya, ko‘prik va miyacha — bitta blok. Makroskopik o‘choqlardan qo‘shimcha bloklar olingan.

source.author: Silva AC va boshq.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation (AIDS Research and Treatment, 2012)

mcq.question: Silva tadqiqotida bemor HAART ni atigi 2 oy qabul qilgan va OITS tufayli vafot etgan. U qaysi guruhga kiritiladi?
mcq.explanation: A guruhga umuman antiretrovirus olmaganlar kiradi. B guruhga 1–2 ta antiretrovirus, 3 oydan kam HAART yoki 2 oydan ortiq tashlab ketilgan HAART olganlar kiradi. C guruh — kamida 3 oy HAART olganlar. 2 oylik HAART 3 oydan kam bo‘lgani uchun B guruh.

source.author: Silva AC va boshq.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation (AIDS Research and Treatment, 2012)

mcq.question: Silva tadqiqotida limfomani xarakterlash uchun immunogistokimyoda qaysi antitana ishlatilgan?
mcq.explanation: Limfomani xarakterlash uchun CD3, CD20, CD30 va CD45 markerlari ishlatilgan. Qolgan uchta variant limfomaga emas, virus va toksoplazmani aniqlashga mo‘ljallangan antitanalar.

source.author: Silva AC va boshq.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation (AIDS Research and Treatment, 2012)

mcq.question: Patolog OIV bilan o‘lgan bemorning bosh miyasida infeksion lezyon topdi. Brazil seriyasiga ko‘ra, MNT infeksiyalari ichida qaysi biri eng ko‘p uchragan?
mcq.explanation: 284 ta autopsiyada toksoplazmoz 85 ta (29,9%) holatda topilgan va eng ko‘p uchragan infeksiya bo‘lgan. Undan keyin kriptokokkoz (15,8%), yiringli bakterial infeksiyalar (3,9%) va sitomegalovirus (2,5%) kelgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Gistologik kesmada ko‘p yadroli gigant hujayralar ko‘rindi, immunogistokimyo o‘tkazilmagan. Bu topilma qaysi MNT lezyoniga xos deb hisoblanadi?
mcq.explanation: Ko‘p yadroli gigant hujayralar MNTda OIV infeksiyasi uchun patognomonik hisoblanadi. Mazkur tadqiqotda OIV-ensefalit shu hujayralarni bevosita ko‘rish orqali tashxislangan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Anamnezida giyohvandlik bor OIV-musbat bemor autopsiya qilinmoqda. Giyohvand bo‘lmaganlarga nisbatan MNTda qaysi lezyon ko‘proq kutiladi?
mcq.explanation: 94 ta giyohvand va 190 ta giyohvand bo‘lmagan bemor solishtirilganda bakterial infeksiyalar (mikobakteriyalar bilan) giyohvandlarda ko‘proq bo‘lgan: 9,6% va 2,6%. Boshqa lezyonlarda statistik farq bo‘lmagan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Yuqori faol antiretrovirus terapiya (HAART) 3 oy va undan ko‘p qabul qilgan C guruhida o‘rtacha omon qolish A guruhiga (davolanmagan) nisbatan qanday bo‘lgan?
mcq.explanation: C guruhida o‘rtacha omon qolish 49,1 oy, A guruhida 11,2 oy bo‘lgan, ya‘ni to‘rt baravardan ko‘p. B guruhida 25,8 oy bo‘lgan. Bu HAARTning aniq foydasini ko‘rsatadi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: OIV bemori pnevmosistli pnevmoniyadan o‘ldi, autopsiyada tasodifan meningioma topildi va klinik tashxis qo‘yilmagan edi. Nomuvofiqlik qaysi turga kiradi?
mcq.explanation: 3-turda kichik kasallik klinik aniqlanmagan va prognozga ta‘siri shubhali yoki yo‘q. Muallif shunday misol sifatida pnevmosistli pnevmoniyali bemordagi meningiomani keltirgan. 1-turda kasallik tashxislansa, prognoz o‘zgarishi mumkin edi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Bemor pnevmotsistli pnevmoniyadan nafas yetishmovchiligi tufayli vafot etdi. Autopsiyada tasodifan meningioma topildi, u hayotida aniqlanmagan, prognozga ta’siri shubhali yoki yo‘q. Goldman bo‘yicha bu qaysi nomuvofiqlik turi?
mcq.explanation: 3-tur: hayotida aniqlanmagan, ammo prognozga ta’siri shubhali yoki yo‘q bo‘lgan kichik kasallik. Muallifler misol sifatida pnevmotsistli pnevmoniyadan o‘lgan bemordagi meningiomani keltirgan. 2-turda esa kasallik muhim, ammo aniqlansa ham prognoz o‘zgarmaydi.

source.author: Silva et al.

mcq.question: OITS bilan kasallangan bemor vafot etdi. Autopsiyada bosh miyaning diffuz B-hujayrali non-Hodgkin limfomasi topildi, hayotida u gumon qilinmagan. Tashxis erta qo‘yilganda prognoz o‘zgarishi mumkin edi. Bu qaysi tur nomuvofiqlik?
mcq.explanation: Bu 1-tur nomuvofiqlik: muhim kasallik hayotida aniqlanmagan va tashxis prognozni o‘zgartirishi mumkin edi. Tadqiqotda 1-tur barcha limfoma holatlarida kuzatilgan, birlamchi MNT limfomalarining birortasi ham hayotida tashxislanmagan.

mcq.question: Karat tadqiqotida minimal invaziv autopsiya (MIA) paytida to‘qima biopsiyasi uchun qaysi a’zolar nishon qilingan?
options: Yurak, jigar, buyrak hamda oshqozon osti bezi
Bosh miya, o‘pka, jigar hamda ichak devori
O‘pka, buyrak, yurak hamda qalqonsimon bez
O‘ng va chap o‘pka, jigar hamda taloq
mcq.explanation: To‘rt a’zo nishon qilingan: jigar, taloq, o‘ng va chap o‘pka. Bundan tashqari qon, orqa miya suyuqligi, siydik va bronxoalveolyar lavaj suyuqligi olingan. Buyrak namunalari tasodifan olingan.

source.author: Karat et al.

mcq.question: Karat tadqiqotida sil dalili topilgan 16 ta marhumning ichida sil eng ko‘p qaysi usul bilan tasdiqlangan?
mcq.explanation: Gistologiya 12 ta (75%) holatda sil dalilini bergan. Kultura 11 ta (69%), Xpert MTB/RIF esa 5 ta (31%) holatda ijobiy bo‘lgan. BinaxNOW siydikda Legionella va pnevmokokk antigenini aniqlash uchun ishlatilgan.

mcq.question: Mikrobiolog MIA namunalarini tahlil qilmoqda: faqat taloqdan ajratilgan gramm-manfiy mikroorganizm topildi, boshqa joyda yo‘q. Bu natija qanday talqin qilinadi?
options: Artefakt: qorin a’zolaridan ifloslanish ehtimoli yuqori
mcq.explanation: Tadqiqotda faqat taloqdan ajratilgan gramm-manfiy mikroorganizmlar artefakt deb hisoblangan, chunki qorin a’zolaridan ifloslanish ehtimoli yuqori. Har bir marhumning ma’lumotlarini tajribali mikrobiologlar alohida ko‘rib chiqib, artefakt va patogenni ajratgan.

mcq.explanation: Klebsiella turlari bakterial infeksiyasi bor 23 marhumning 14 tasida (61%) taloqdan tashqari namunalarda o‘sgan. S. aureus 4 tada (17%), Pseudomonas 2 tada (9%), Salmonella 1 tada (4%) aniqlangan.

mcq.question: Gistologga yuborilgan o‘pka kesmasi Grocott usulida bo‘yaldi. Unda kichik, yarim oy shaklidagi xamirturushsimon zamburug‘lar ko‘rindi. Qaysi tashxis eng mos?
mcq.explanation: Kichik, yarim oy shaklidagi xamirturushsimon zamburug‘lar Grocott bo‘yog‘ida Pneumocystis jirovecii pnevmoniyasiga xos. Kriptokokk xamirturushlari polimorf bo‘ladi. CMV yadro inklyuziyalari bilan, mikobakteriyalar Ziehl-Neelsen (ZN) usulida ko‘rinadi.

mcq.question: MIA kuzatuv uchun soddalashtirilmoqda. Sil aniqlash uchun qaysi namunalar guruhi eng yuqori natija beradi?
options: Nafas yo‘llari namunalari: BAL va o‘pka
Orqa miya suyuqligi va qon namunalari
mcq.explanation: Muallif fikricha, nafas yo‘llari namunalari (bronxoalveolyar lavaj va o‘pka to‘qimasi) eng yuqori natija beradi. BAL Xpert va BAL madaniy ekishi 9 ta holatni aniqladi. O‘pka ekishi yana 2 ta, gistologiya yana 3 ta holat qo‘shdi, jami silning 88%.
